zoe: hi all 👋 day 2 here. need the Env Panel for onboarding: qa admin to run flag smoke tests + prod readonly for runbook review. who do i ask?
rahul: welcome zoe! open an infra-permissions ticket and include manager approval. infra can usually do QA admin same day; prod readonly may require SCIM sync.
zoe: can you paste the ticket text i should use?
rahul: short one: 
```
Title: Env Panel access - zoe
Requester: zoe
Manager: <manager-name>
Environments: qa(admin), prod(readonly)
Flags: onboarding.*
Duration: 7 days
Purpose: onboarding verification + runbook walkthrough
```
zoe: thanks, filed INF-8003 and added mgr approval.
infra: QA admin granted. Prod readonly pending SCIM group sync; estimate ~30m. We'll update when complete.
access-bot: verification: Console -> avatar -> "My permissions" OR `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://console.internal/api/v1/me/roles` and check for `\"env_panel\"` roles. If mismatch after 30m tag @infra.
zoe: got QA admin, will wait for prod. thanks everyone :)
